notes:
Prowl Mirror is the companion app for Prowl, a free macOS app (https://prowl.cat, source code at https://github.com/onevcat/Prowl) that runs AI coding agents in terminal panes. The device connects directly to the user's own Mac over the local network or a VPN, encrypted with a key created at pairing. There is no account and no server in between.

REVIEWING WITHOUT A MAC
On the first screen, tap "Try the Demo" under "Pair with a Mac". The demo runs the real app on built-in sample data, so every feature can be reviewed:
1. Agents: the home screen lists sample agents by project, in every state (Blocked, Working, Done, Idle), and two terminals.
2. Answer a question: open "Fix flaky prefetch test" (Blocked) and tap "1 Yes" in the permission panel. The agent runs the tests and replies.
3. Chat and Terminal: the toolbar button switches between the conversation and the terminal screen. In Terminal, the key bar sends keys and the arrows page through the screen.
4. Stop: open "Scan unused images" (Working) and tap the Stop button.
5. Message: type in the Message field of an agent and send it; the sample agent replies.
6. New Session: the + button starts a new agent with a first message.
7. Settings: the gear button at the top left. In the demo it offers Exit Demo, Pair with a Mac, and Settings with About, the privacy policy and the terms of use.

PAIRING WITH A REAL MAC (optional)
Install Prowl from https://prowl.cat on a Mac, turn on Settings > Remote Mirror > Enable Remote Mirror, click the Remote Mirror button in the toolbar, choose Add a Device, and scan the QR code with the app. The Mac and the device must be on the same network.

NOTIFICATIONS
Optional and off by default. They need a paired Mac with notifications turned on in Prowl. The content is end-to-end encrypted between the Mac and the device.

PERMISSIONS
Camera: only to scan the pairing QR code. Local network: only to reach the paired Mac.

This version has no in-app purchases.
